meta.name: stealth-browser
meta.description: Ultimate stealth browser automation with anti-detection, Cloudflare bypass, CAPTCHA solving, persistent sessions, and silent operation. Use for any web automation requiring bot detection evasion, login persistence, headless browsing, or bypassing security measures. Triggers on "bypass cloudflare", "solve captcha", "stealth browse", "silent automation", "persistent login", "anti-detection", or any task needing undetectable browser automation. When user asks to "login to X website", automatically use headed mode for login, then save session for future headless reuse.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绕过反爬和验证码，静默自动化操控浏览器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化操作网站但总被检测或拦截
copy.tagline_en: Bypass anti-detection and CAPTCHAs for silent browser automation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate websites but keep getting blocked or detected

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动用隐身浏览器打开网站，绕过 Cloudflare 验证、解决 CAPTCHA、保存登录状态，并静默执行自动化任务。
howto.when: 当你要求“绕过 Cloudflare”、“解决验证码”、“隐身浏览”、“静默自动化”、“保持登录”、“反检测”，或让 Claude 登录某个网站时触发。

say.text: 帮我登录微博并保存会话。
say.note: Claude 会打开可见浏览器让你手动登录，然后保存会话。

say.text: 绕过 Cloudflare 打开这个网站。
静默抓取知乎首页内容。
say.note: Claude 会在后台无头浏览器中抓取页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically open websites in a stealth browser, bypass Cloudflare challenges, solve CAPTCHAs, save login sessions, and perform silent automation tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "bypass Cloudflare", "solve captcha", "stealth browse", "silent automation", "persistent login", "anti-detection", or ask Claude to log in to a website.

say_en.text: Log in to Weibo and save the session.
say_en.note: Claude opens a visible browser for manual login, then saves the session.

say_en.text: Bypass Cloudflare and open this website.
say_en.note: Claude automatically bypasses Cloudflare challenges in stealth mode.
Claude scrapes the page in a headless browser in the background.
